items.originalTitle: TGR Haas F1 Team can confirm that Esteban Ocon will no longer compete on its behalf in the 2026 FIA Formula 1 World Championship. Rafael Câmara will ...
items.summaryEn:
TGR Haas F1 Team can confirm that Esteban Ocon will no longer compete on its behalf in the 2026 FIA Formula 1 World Championship. 
Rafael Câmara will now partner Ollie Bearman in the team at the São Paulo Grand Prix.
Rafael will make his Formula 1 debut on home-soil this year having last month been announced as one of TGR Haas F1 Team’s full-time driver signings for the 2027 FIA Formula 1 World Championship. 
#HaasF1 #F1
detailZh:
TGR 哈斯 F1 Team确认，埃斯蒂班·奥康将不再代表车队参加2026年FIA一级方程式世界锦标赛。
拉斐尔·卡马罗将搭档奥利·贝尔曼参加圣保罗大奖赛。
拉斐尔将在今年在家乡首次参加一级方程式比赛，上个月已被宣布为TGR 哈斯 F1 Team 2027年FIA一级方程式世界锦标赛的全职车手签约之一。
#HaasF1 #F1
detailEn:
TGR Haas F1 Team can confirm that Esteban Ocon will no longer compete on its behalf in the 2026 FIA Formula 1 World Championship. 
Rafael Câmara will now partner Ollie Bearman in the team at the São Paulo Grand Prix.
Rafael will make his Formula 1 debut on home-soil this year having last month been announced as one of TGR Haas F1 Team’s full-time driver signings for the 2027 FIA Formula 1 World Championship. 
#HaasF1 #F1
